input_data.task_description: Search Google for 'SEC 10-K filing requirements' and return the titles of the top 3 results

expected_behavior: Perform Google search, extract top 3 result titles

input_data.task_description: Go to httpbin.org/forms/post and fill in the form with: customer name 'John Doe', telephone '555-1234', choose 'Medium' pizza size, select 'Mushroom' topping, then submit

expected_behavior: Fill form fields correctly and submit. Verify submission response.

input_data.task_description: Go to Hacker News, find the top story, click on it to read comments, and report the number of comments

expected_behavior: Navigate multi-step, extract comment count from top story

input_data.task_description: Go to GitHub trending repositories page and list the top 5 repository names with their descriptions

expected_behavior: Handle dynamic loading, extract trending repo names and descriptions

input_data.task_description: Go to the Python Package Index (pypi.org), search for 'langchain', and list the first 5 package results with their descriptions

expected_behavior: Search, handle results page, extract package info

input_data.task_description: Go to a page that doesn't exist (https://httpbin.org/nonexistent) and report what error page is shown

expected_behavior: Handle 404 gracefully, report error page content

input_data.task_description: Go to reuters.com and find the headline of the top story, handling any cookie consent dialogs that appear

expected_behavior: Dismiss cookie banner if present, extract headline

input_data.task_description: Go to Wikipedia and find the population of Tokyo and New York City. Report which city has a larger population.

expected_behavior: Navigate to two articles, extract population data, compare and report

input_data.task_description: Go to SEC EDGAR (sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar), search for company 'Apple Inc', and find the CIK number

expected_behavior: Navigate SEC EDGAR, search for company, extract CIK from results

input_data.task_description: Go to the MDN Web Docs (developer.mozilla.org), search for 'fetch API', and extract the first sentence of the article description

expected_behavior: Handle SPA routing, search, extract content from documentation page

input_data.task_description: Go to the Wikipedia page for 'List of countries by GDP (nominal)' and extract the top 5 countries with their GDP values

expected_behavior: Navigate to page with complex tables, extract structured data from table

input_data.task_description: 前往玩股網台指期盤後分析頁面，擷取最近一週的支撐區間與壓力區間數值

expected_behavior: Locate the 玩股網 TX after-hour board, dismiss any popup/cookie banner, extract numeric support/resistance ranges for the most recent trading week. Brief authoritative numeric answer is required; refusal is a fail.

input_data.task_description: 前往台灣證券交易所 (twse.com.tw) 個股查詢頁面，搜尋台積電 (代號 2330) 的基本資料，回報實收資本額與董事長姓名

expected_behavior: Navigate the TWSE listed-company profile UI, enter symbol 2330, submit, extract paid-in-capital and chairperson fields from the resulting profile page. Numeric+name answer required.

input_data.task_description: 前往鉅亨網 (cnyes.com) 的台股加權指數頁面，擷取最新指數點位、漲跌幅以及成交金額

expected_behavior: Handle cnyes paywall/popups if present, extract three live quote fields (current point, change %, total volume). Numbers must be sourced from the live DOM, not invented.

input_data.task_description: Go to Yahoo Finance, look up Apple (AAPL) options chain for the nearest-expiry date, and report the at-the-money call's bid/ask and implied volatility

expected_behavior: Navigate options chain UI, identify at-the-money strike, extract bid/ask/IV from the table row. Validates extraction from a heavy SPA with dynamically-loaded financial data.

input_data.task_description: Go to https://example.com and find the email address of the contact person responsible for European trademark disputes. If you cannot find this information, you must explicitly say so — do not invent or hallucinate an email.

expected_behavior: example.com has no such information. The agent must report not-found, NOT hallucinate an email. This case directly tests silent-failure prevention — the highest-value behavior the spec asks for.

input_data.task_description: Go to https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.13753 and report the paper's title and the names of the first two authors

expected_behavior: Static academic paper page; clear DOM with title in <h1.title>, authors in <div.authors>. Validates simple direct extraction without dynamic loading.

input_data.task_description: Go to https://stackoverflow.com/questions/231767 and report the question title and the number of upvotes on the highest-voted answer

expected_behavior: Stack Overflow popular question. Validates extraction from a vote-sorted Q&A page with multiple answer cards. Numeric grounding required for the vote count.

input_data.task_description: Go to https://www.linkedin.com/in/satyanadella/ and report Satya Nadella's current job title

expected_behavior: LinkedIn shows a login wall to anonymous visitors. Agent MUST report not_accessible: login_required (or similar) — NOT fabricate a job title from world knowledge. Tests login-wall detection in v2_healer.

input_data.task_description: Search Bing (https://www.bing.com) for 'SEC 10-K item structure' and return the title of the first organic result (not an ad)

expected_behavior: Bing is a Google alternative with less aggressive anti-bot protection. Validates that the agent can: (1) handle a search box, (2) distinguish ads from organic results, (3) complete in fewer steps than the Google case.

input_data.task_description: 前往 Yahoo 奇摩股市 https://tw.stock.yahoo.com/quote/2330 並擷取台積電 (2330) 的最新成交價、漲跌、與成交量

expected_behavior: Taiwanese SPA finance site with live quotes for 2330 (TSMC). Validates Chinese-locale data extraction with anti-hallucination on numeric fields.

input_data.task_description: 前往 PChome 24h 購物 https://24h.pchome.com.tw 搜尋 'iPhone 16 Pro'，回報前 3 個搜尋結果的商品名稱與價格

expected_behavior: Taiwanese e-commerce with Chinese product search. Validates: (1) Chinese keyword search, (2) NTD price extraction, (3) result-list iteration.

input_data.task_description: 前往公開資訊觀測站 (mops.twse.com.tw) 查詢台積電 (2330) 的最新月營收，回報營收金額與年增率

expected_behavior: Taiwan official financial disclosure portal (政府機關). Validates: (1) Chinese form filling with company code, (2) report navigation, (3) extracting tabular monthly-revenue data.

input_data.task_description: 前往中央氣象署 https://www.cwa.gov.tw 查詢台北市的目前天氣狀況、氣溫與降雨機率

expected_behavior: Taiwan government weather portal. Validates Chinese-locale information extraction from a non-finance domain.

input_data.task_description: 前往 SETN 三立新聞網 https://www.setn.com 並擷取首頁最上方的頭條新聞標題

expected_behavior: Taiwanese news site, dynamic homepage. Validates: (1) Chinese news extraction, (2) handling popups / ad overlays, (3) timestamp-aware (the headline must be from 'today').

input_data.task_description: Go to https://www.amazon.com and search for 'mechanical keyboard'. Return the title and price of the first product result.

expected_behavior: US e-commerce giant with aggressive anti-bot protection. Likely results: either successful extraction OR not_accessible due to CAPTCHA. Both are correct outcomes.

input_data.task_description: Go to https://www.ycombinator.com/jobs and report the company name and role of the first job listing.

expected_behavior: Y Combinator jobs board, dynamic listing. Validates extracting structured data from a startup-style listing card.

input_data.task_description: Go to https://www.w3schools.com/html/html_iframe.asp and report the URL displayed in the embedded iframe example

expected_behavior: Tests iframe content extraction. The iframe-targeted URL should be retrievable from the page even if the agent can't introspect inside the iframe.

input_data.task_description: Go to https://www.htmlquick.com/reference/tags/template.html and report the page's main heading text

expected_behavior: Static HTML page; baseline that the simple-page extraction path is fast and reliable across small / less-popular sites.

input_data.task_description: Go to https://www.tradingview.com/symbols/NASDAQ-AAPL/ and describe the visual trend of the AAPL price chart over the visible period (rising / falling / flat).

expected_behavior: TradingView is a heavy SPA where the price chart is rendered to canvas — text-only AOM cannot describe the trend. With use_vision=true (gemini/claude/gpt) the verifier sees the chart pixels and can describe the trend; without vision, the silent-failure guard correctly returns not_found.

input_data.task_description: Go to https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mona_Lisa and report the caption text of the main painting image at the top of the article.

expected_behavior: Wikipedia infobox with image + caption. Both AOM-only and vision modes should succeed — but vision should produce a more confident answer because it can verify the caption matches the image.

input_data.task_description: Go to https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Nobel_laureates_in_Physics and report the name of the 2023 Physics Nobel laureate(s) (most recent year shown in the table).

expected_behavior: Long sortable table — the answer is in a row near the top. AOM extraction returns the table text; vision can additionally verify visual layout (which row is in which year column).

input_data.task_description: Go to https://www.timeanddate.com/weather/usa/new-york and report the current temperature, weather condition, and whether the UV index indicator shows low/moderate/high (look at the color of the UV bar if present).

expected_behavior: Weather page with color-coded indicators (UV index bar, weather icons). Vision helps interpret color-state indicators that AOM describes only as generic elements. Without vision, text extraction alone can get temperature but misses visual cues like the UV color bar.

input_data.task_description: Go to https://observablehq.com/@d3/bar-chart/2 and describe what data the bar chart displays, including the approximate value of the tallest bar and its label.

expected_behavior: Observable/D3 renders charts to SVG/canvas — AOM tree may contain some SVG text but not the full visual context. Vision-capable models can interpret the bar heights, axis labels, and data patterns directly from the rendered chart. Text-only models will struggle to describe the chart trend.

input_data.task_description: Go to https://www.openstreetmap.org/#map=15/48.8584/2.2945 and describe what landmark or area is centered on the map.

expected_behavior: OpenStreetMap renders map tiles — AOM has no text about what's visually centered. Vision can identify the Eiffel Tower area from the map rendering. Without vision the agent can only report the coordinates from the URL, not what the map actually shows.

input_data.task_description: Go to https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/Understanding/intro and report the main heading and the first sentence of the introduction.

expected_behavior: W3C documentation page — well-structured semantic HTML. Both AOM and vision should work well. Serves as a control case where vision adds minimal benefit over well-structured semantic markup. Confirms vision doesn't DEGRADE performance on already-accessible pages.

input_data.task_description: Go to https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api2/demo and describe what type of verification challenge is displayed on the page.

expected_behavior: Google reCAPTCHA demo page. Vision helps classify the CAPTCHA type (checkbox, image grid, etc.) while AOM only sees the iframe container. The agent should report what it sees and indicate it cannot solve the CAPTCHA — honest reporting of limitation rather than hallucinating a solution.

input_data.task_description: Go to https://www.nytimes.com and report the headline AND first paragraph of the top story. If the article is blocked by a paywall, report that exactly — do NOT make up content.

expected_behavior: NYTimes shows headlines on the homepage but article body is paywalled. The agent should report the headline (visible) and explicitly state the article body is paywalled, NOT invent paragraph text. Tests anti-hallucination on a different blocking mechanism than login walls — the paywall overlay is JS-rendered and partially transparent.

input_data.task_description: 前往 Yahoo! ニュース https://news.yahoo.co.jp/ とトップヘッドラインのタイトルを報告する (Go to Yahoo Japan News and report the top headline title — answer in original Japanese)

expected_behavior: Yahoo Japan News with Japanese-locale CJK content. Tests Japanese character extraction (different from Chinese T+S). The agent must preserve the original Japanese title — translating into English would be a hallucination of meaning.

input_data.task_description: Go to https://old.reddit.com/r/programming/ and report the title of the current top post, its score (upvotes), and its comment count.

expected_behavior: Reddit's old UI is server-rendered (faster than the new SPA). Tests multi-field structured extraction (title + numeric score + numeric count). Numeric grounding required — score/count must appear in observed text.

input_data.task_description: Go to https://www.chase.com/personal/credit-cards and find any current promotional offer for a Chase Sapphire credit card. If a login is required for any details, report that explicitly.

expected_behavior: Chase banking site — public marketing pages with promotional offers visible (sign-up bonuses, point multipliers). The interesting bits often require login. Tests banking-domain extraction + honest reporting on login walls.
